results.description:
The Sunday Times bestseller is now a New Original Series from visionary showrunner Mike Flanagan, coming soon to Prime Video.

Carrie is Stephen King's legendary debut, the bestselling smash hit that put him on the map as a global icon.
In a world where bullies rule, one girl holds a secret power.

Unpopular and tormented, Carrie White's life takes a terrifying turn when her hidden abilities become a weapon of horror.

***

Carrie White is no ordinary girl.

Carrie White has the gift of telekinesis.

To be invited to Prom Night by Tommy Ross is a dream come true for Carrie - the first
step towards social acceptance by her high school colleagues.

But events will take a decidedly macabre turn on that horrifying and endless night as she
is forced to exercise her terrible gift on the town that mocks and loathes her . . .
